text:
alexa: pushed a composable Next.js starter (LangChain + LlamaIndex) to my fork: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-composable-starter. Looking for quick parity check vs our JS+Py SDKs for auth/retries + a sample eval harness. want to avoid onboarding friction.

sam: nice! can you include an eval harness & a minimal telemetry hook? would help perf/latency comparisons :eyes:

alexa: added a simple eval folder with prompt_sets + a telemetry shim (client-side events -> console for now). question: JS SDK v0.7 seems to drop Authorization header on internal redirects — observed 401s on edge functions. also retry behavior doesn't backoff properly.

priya: repro steps?

alexa: repro:
```js
// edge/api/generate.js
export default async function handler(req, res) {
  const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'open-redwood/hero-3b', prompt: 'hi' })
  })
  const data = await r.json();
  res.status(r.status).json(data);
}
```
On cold start when using our edge runtime + Vercel redirects, the auth header disappears and we get 401. Also the SDK's default retry wrapper currently retries immediately 3x without jitter.

sam: sounds like two bugs: header strip on redirect (edge fetch?) and retry/backoff in js-sdk. I've filed issues: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/issues/456 and /457. Can you add a tiny test in eval/ that reproduces 401 so CI catches it?

alexa: will add a Playwright test that hits the edge route with a stubbed upstream. adding now.

priya: for quick mitigation, we can recommend putting auth into a signed cookie for edge builds or set fetch redirect: 'manual' to preserve headers. also I'll prototype a jittered exponential backoff in the SDK patch.

sam: lgtm. once alexa pushes test + tiny README update about 'edge caveats' we can merge to templates org. thank you :thumbsup:

alexa: PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-composable-starter/pull/12 — contains eval harness, telemetry shim, and test. tagging @devex for review.

devex-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://deploy.preview/next-composable-starter/xyz (auto)

sam: quick code nits in PR, leaving comments.

alexa: addressed comments, pushed. merging after one more :rocket:
